ROLE & OBJECTIVE: Build a complete 8-second GOOGLE_FLOW commercial video for TikTok, covering the single block beat.
PRODUCT TRUTH LOCK: BOSMAX Serum 5ML slim matte-black cylindrical roll-on, glossy black cap, white BOSMAX HERBS wordmark, leaf icon, Herbal Oil Roll On label. EXACTLY lip balm size, fits into fingers naturally.
CONTINUITY & STATE LOCK: This is the opening prompt set. Establish the scene cleanly without implying any prior unseen clip. Scale lock: EXACTLY lip balm size, fits into fingers naturally. Character continuity: Keep the same presenter identity, age range, wardrobe tone, and hand dominance across all blocks. Setting/camera continuity: Maintain the same commercial setting, camera family, and lighting direction unless a planned proof cut is declared. Start state: Open on the first proof beat for BOSMAX with the same presenter and product in hand. Continuity anchor: Establish the opening continuity anchor from zero.
VISUAL STORY: Visual action: Dalam kereta di parkir, lelaki ambil BOSMAX dari konsol dan sapu pada pergelangan tangan, cahaya siang lembut. Role focus: single block. Narrative function: SINGLE_BLOCK.
SHOT & CAMERA RULES: Keep chronology literal and continuation-ready for Google Flow. Lock product position, label direction, scale, avatar identity, wardrobe, scene, lighting, and camera direction across the seam. Do not depend on vague 'from last frame' shorthand; spell out continuity explicitly.
SPOKEN DIALOGUE: On-camera presenter says the line directly to camera with visible mouth, lips, jaw, and facial muscles in frame-accurate lip-sync from the first moment. No voice-over. No narration. No off-camera speech. No audio-only dialogue. No unseen speaker: Luar panas, badan cepat rasa tak selesa dalam kereta kan? BOSMAX kecil, senang capai, terus sapu masa berhenti. Tap tengok harga sekarang, boss.
VOICE & DELIVERY: Spoken delivery in Malay at a brisk, conversational UGC pace. Keep the presenter talking naturally across the full 8 seconds with real breaths between phrases — fill the beat edge to edge so there is no silent dead air for the model to fill with drifting or glitching motion. Do not rush the words or clip the final phrase.
CTA & END FRAME: Deliver the spoken CTA naturally: Tap tengok harga sekarang, boss. End frame: End on a clean CTA close with product hero visibility preserved.
NO_OVERLAY: NO_OVERLAY. No visual text layer of any kind. Spoken hook/body/CTA must remain spoken and never be converted into visual copy.
